import subprocess,json,datetime,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
stage=sys.argv[1]
owner='a1ebdc7a-d497-4334-9fed-309aec071b25'
pid='cb045295-cf70-445c-99a7-46fc0618e58e'
queries={
'reader':"SELECT current_user,current_setting('default_transaction_read_only') AS read_only,current_setting('statement_timeout') AS statement_timeout",
'roles':f"SELECT r.role_name FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id='{owner}'",
'product':f"SELECT id,name,type,status,user_id,price FROM course_products WHERE id='{pid}'",
'grants':f"SELECT product_id,status,source,created_at,revoked_at FROM product_entitlements WHERE user_id='{owner}' AND product_id='{pid}'",
'buyer_order_count':f"SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM commerce_orders WHERE buyer_user_id='{owner}'",
'identity_shape':f"SELECT first_name IS NULL AS first_name_sql_null,last_name IS NULL AS last_name_sql_null,lower(trim(last_name))='null' AS last_name_literal_null,lower(trim(first_name))='null' AS first_name_literal_null FROM users WHERE user_id='{owner}'"
}
a={'key':stage,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'account_alias':'OWNER-A','scope':'Read-only synthetic Course and own grants/role'}
for key,q in queries.items():
 r=subprocess.run(['psql','-w','-h','127.0.0.1','-p','15432','-U','vp_test_reader','-d','video_platform_db','-At','-c',"SELECT coalesce(json_agg(q),'[]'::json) FROM ("+q+') q;'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,env={**os.environ,'PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT':'8'})
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit('Read-only query failed: '+key)
 a[key]=json.loads(r.stdout)
assert a['reader'][0]['read_only']=='on'
p=Path('/Users/tamastyukodi/Development/video-platform-UI-docs/qa/runs/2026-09-30-01/evidence/browser-customer-relationship-batch-2026-10-03.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else []
assert stage not in {v['key'] for v in x}
x.append(a);p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(a))
